patterns.comment: Read a native percent comment only when its first percent is not a directive and no opening brace follows after directives. Follows journey.md#the-statement-context.

Read a case-insensitive section and its text up to hash, colon, semicolon or a common-comment boundary. Follows journey.md#the-statement-context.

Read each person between the second colon, commas and the third colon or data end. Follows journey.md#tasks.
Read each people-list comma as a separator. Follows journey.md#tasks.
